parts.text:
Fixed the wafer count to count unique `wafer_id` values for timestamps in the inclusive-start, exclusive-end range. Offset timestamps are parsed to their UTC instants, and the UI now displays `Distinct wafers inspected: N`.

`npm test` passes: 2 tests passed. No inspection data or dependencies were changed.
